flow: Infected Humans (P)->Environment Ebola pathogen in environment (U)
Deceased Infectious bodies (S)->Environment Ebola pathogen in environment (U)
param: α₁ Recruitment (birth/entry) rate into Susceptible humans (A)
α₂ Recruitment/importation rate into Infected humans (P)
ε Natural death rate of humans (applies to Susceptible and Recovered; also included in combined death terms)
ψ₁ Effective contact/transmission coefficient for direct transmission from Infected humans (P) to Susceptible humans (A) (mass-action term A*P*ψ₁)
ψ₂ Effective contact/transmission coefficient for indirect transmission via contaminated Environment (U) to Susceptible humans (A) (mass-action term A*U*ψ₂)
ψ₃ Effective contact/transmission coefficient for transmission from Deceased infectious bodies (S) to Susceptible humans (A) (mass-action term A*S*ψ₃)
ρ₁ Disease-induced death rate for Infected humans (P); combined with ε in flow P→S labeled (ε+ρ₁)
ρ₂ Shedding/contamination rate from Infected humans (P) into Environment (U)
ρ₃ Quarantining/isolation rate moving Infected humans (P) to Quarantined humans (F)
ω₁ Recovery rate of Quarantined humans (F) to Recovered (K)
ω₂ Disease-induced death rate for Quarantined humans (F); combined with ε in flow F→S labeled (ε+ω₂)
h Shedding/contamination rate from Deceased infectious bodies (S) into Environment (U)
c Burial/removal rate of Deceased bodies (S) out of the system (safe burial)
b Clearance/decay/removal rate of Ebola virus/pathogen from Environment (U) out of the system
d External input/source term adding Ebola virus/pathogen into Environment (U)
ε+ρ₁ Total death rate for Infected humans (natural + disease-induced)
ε+ω₂ Total death rate for Quarantined humans (natural + disease-induced)
